newsitem.title: UK: UK longer leading index up revised 0.8 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: UK longer leading index up revised 0.8 pct in July.

text.p: The UK longer leading index rose a revised 0.8 percent in July, the Office for National Statistics said on Monday.
The shorter leading index fell a revised 0.3 percent, while the coincident index was up 0.2 percent in July, the ONS said.
The longer leading index, which has risen since December, rose again due to an increase in housing starts and Confederation of British Industry optimism.
The shorter leading index fell for the first time this year with falling share prices and lower seasonally adjusted new car registrations outweighing rises in CBI new orders.
